DOSL7::health
       Returns DOSL7 server health value for current virtual server

SYNOPSIS
       DOSL7::health

DESCRIPTION
       Syntax

       DOSL7::health

RETURN VALUE
       Return health value as integer. Lower values are good health. Bad health is value > 1^23.

VALID DURING
       ALL_EVENTS

EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG

		   --First introduced the command.
